name: nTSSG::cTSSGSystemBehaviorTraits::RegistryFor (cTSSGSystem's event registry)
notes: Lane SM (H1b part 9). Hooked (cdecl, 32-byte CRC site). A function-local static map built on first use and returned from every call, `attribute` stored under `id` first when id is not 0: a copy of the base registry (0x1485f0) plus the events 0xca7ccbbc (record 0xff7890) and 0x2b5745f8 (record 0xff78a8), each with its last word 4. SG_TSSGSystem_Registry: 600 seeds of 1-6 calls (ids from a fixed pool plus random, random records), against the original started from the state its first-use build leaves (the parents' maps and this map placed at their statics with the guards and once bytes marked done, the holder's registrations then run through the real registry; ours starts from nothing); after every call the returned map's identity and every record (key, id, name, three words, last) of this map, its parent and the base registry are compared. Mutants: record swapped, id store skipped, parent copy skipped, each killed.

name: nTSSG::cTSSGSystemBehaviorTraits registry holder (once-byte step)
notes: Lane SM. The registry's holder (run on every call of 0x253de0, a once byte skipping it after the first): makes a small object kept in a static (read by nothing) and runs the base events (0x1464f0) and stores the two events through 0x253de0. Folded into RegistryFor as the first-use build (the base events and those two events); SG_TSSGSystem_Registry plants the original's state from it and compares what ours builds. Its only caller is the hooked 0x253de0.
